tasks.title: Implement tmux worker backend and execution wrapper in harness/tmux_worker.py
acceptance_criteria: `harness/tmux_worker.py` is successfully created as a new module.
It defines and exposes `TmuxWorkerResult`, `_ExitedProc`, `seed_from_prompt_file`, `run_tmux_worker`, and `spawn_claude_tmux` functions/classes.
Exposes `spawn_claude_tmux(agent, resolved_prompt, env, config, *, dbus_sock=None) -> _ExitedProc` interface.

Implements environment preparation, config seeding, command jailing via `harness/agent_jail.py`, prompt writing, and tmux execution orchestration using seams from `overseer/tmux_session.py` and `overseer/tmux_seams.py`.
Consumes task and environment parameters `JANUSMASK_TASK_ID`, `JANUSMASK_WORK_DIR`, and `JANUSMASK_STATE_DIR` correctly.

spec.objective: Implement the tmux worker execution backend and process wrappers to support interactive Claude execution in tmux.
functional_requirements: Implement `TmuxWorkerResult` and `_ExitedProc` classes with the required interface (poll, wait, kill, returncode, assignable `_work_dir`).
Implement `run_tmux_worker` to execute/orchestrate commands under tmux.
Implement `spawn_claude_tmux` to prepare environment, jail command using `agent_jail`, write prompt, and start the tmux worker execution.
spec.interfaces: exposes `spawn_claude_tmux(agent, resolved_prompt, env, config, *, dbus_sock=None) -> _ExitedProc` where `_ExitedProc` has `poll() -> 0`, `returncode=0`, `wait(timeout=None) -> 0`, `kill()` no-op, and assignable `_work_dir`
edge_cases: Config missing keys or having empty values handles defaults gracefully.
Environments without bwrap or tmux configured handle errors without hanging.
non_goals: INTEGRATION-TEST EXCUSE (REQUIRED verbatim in every generated task's `spec.non_goals`): live end-to-end integration of this backend (spawning a real interactive claude in tmux for a real worker task) is an OPERATOR-VALIDATED step performed AFTER merge by flipping the flag; it is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE for automated leaf tests, which exercise pure seams over injected fakes only (no real tmux/claude spawn in any test). This excuses the `missing_integration_test` plan gate.
Do NOT change the headless path, the agy STDIN path, the synthesis `active_agents`, or any `agents.*` entry.
Do NOT remove or rewrite any existing `spawn_agent` branch; the new branch is purely additive and flag-gated.
Do NOT flip the default to `tmux` here (operator does it after live validation).
Do NOT touch NGv2 (the agy-default hunt is the separate epic `ngv2_agy_default_hunt`).
Do NOT scrape the TUI for the deliverable; the deliverable is the outbox files claude writes.
spec.implementation_notes: Create `harness/tmux_worker.py` using helper functions from `overseer/tmux_session.py`, `overseer/tmux_seams.py`, and `harness/agent_jail.py`. Ensure the interfaces and classes match the requirements.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Mock config and environment parameters (JANUSMASK_TASK_ID, JANUSMASK_WORK_DIR, JANUSMASK_STATE_DIR). Mock tmux sessions and commands.

token_budget_ratio.note: Implementation of tmux_worker.py is medium complexity. Verification uses mock seams to avoid real tmux spawns.
